boundary: Internal exact-type VECTOR returned values and value arguments only. Runtime evidence is offline; other aggregate results/value forms and controller execution remain unverified.

rules.documented: The VECTOR type explicitly allows VECTOR function return types and requires VECTOR expressions. Chapter 5 requires a RETURN value and describes the runtime error if no RETURN executes.
rules.implemented: Internal routines may declare a VECTOR result. Each RETURN checks all initialized X/Y/Z through the existing REAL policy, then builds independent writable VECTOR storage before local-frame cleanup. Results may come from local/global/reference storage or VECTOR expressions/functions; assignments retain existing destination storage.
rules.restriction: Broader ARRAY results, direct STRING results and external FROM routines, VECTOR aliases/constructors, positional conversion and source POSITION orientation initialization remain blocked. Falling through a function raises a source-located offline error; native alarm/task behavior is not claimed.
rules.tests: tests/test_vector_routines.py: local/global/formal/field/element/operator returns, recursion, SELECT/labels/FOR, copies and frame cleanup

rules.documented: Expression arguments are passed as temporary copies; parentheses turn a variable argument into a value expression. Modifying the parameter does not modify the original argument. VECTOR arguments must be VECTOR expressions.
rules.implemented: Grouped VECTOR variables/fields/elements, VECTOR operator results and returned VECTOR values get independent writable temporary storage. The source is validated before the callee executes. Bare ordinary VECTOR arguments keep references. Forwarding a bare value-formal references its owned temporary; grouping it makes another copy.
rules.restriction: No cross-type or robot-dependent positional conversion. Whole ARRAY values remain blocked; positional/joint values use positional_routine_semantics.json. Bare protected POSITION orientation arguments stay rejected; explicit grouped/returned initialized orientation vectors detach into writable copies, tested only with a synthetic host fixture.
rules.tests: tests/test_vector_routines.py: caller isolation, repeated/mixed arguments, forwarding, captured fields, single evaluation and initialized protected fixture

rules.implemented: Potential parameter/global writes, delays, output and ABORT remain transitive. Operator expressions, indexed targets and multiple-argument calls retain existing conservative evaluation-order guards. Reports record vector_returns/vector_value_arguments, independent-copy policy and reference/value passing modes. Numeric errors and uninitialized values are checked before exposing a returned value/temporary.
rules.restriction: Effect analysis is deliberately conservative: potential parameter writes stay effects even at a value-argument call site. Existing exact arithmetic, FOR counters, call-depth, destination protection, aggregate UNINIT and numeric I/O restrictions remain.

unresolved: Native VECTOR return/value ABI and runtime observation
Broader ARRAY results, whole ARRAY value arguments and native positional ownership
General REAL rounding and VECTOR constructors

structure_routine_update.boundary: Prior exact named STRUCTURE results and independent writable value copies are supported with full recursive initialization/type/capacity guards. Whole ARRAY values and controller behavior remain blocked; restricted results use array_routine_semantics.json; exact positional copies are covered in positional_routine_semantics.json.

positional_routine_update.boundary: Exact initialized CONFIG/XYZWPR/XYZWPREXT/POSITION and exact-width JOINTPOS results/writable value copies are supported. POSITION protection, CONFIG scalar value-only passing, effects and conversion-context guards remain; no frame, kinematic or controller behavior is supplied.

array_routine_update.boundary: Internal unsized anonymous outer ARRAY results with supported scalar, explicitly bounded STRING, record, exact-width joint or prior named fixed ARRAY elements, one outer dimension and at most three logical dimensions. Independent recursively checked copies and direct assignment only; all scalar leaves known/initialized. Exact STRING element capacities retained and checked without result truncation. Named outer results, flat multidimensional result sources/declarations, unspecified STRING capacities, direct STRING returns and whole ARRAY value arguments remain blocked.
